stance_rationale: QVALUE has a valid multi-date alpha matrix at the package-referenced path, but the approval claim is not admissible under QEPM: hard constraints, RF-A2, RF-A6, lockbox separation, and No Silent Override artifacts fail. Treat it as a research candidate requiring rerun and rebuttal, not an approved alpha package.

harvey_t.note: Reported as Bonferroni IC t over 17 within-track tests; no Newey-West HAC or required 5-spec portfolio regression evidence.

dsr.note: Within-track only; package itself admits cross-cycle trials are not fully reflected.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Package-referenced stage_artifacts/WT_WT_D20260529_004_QVALUE/alpha_scores.parquet exists with Date,Ticker,alpha columns, 79,149 rows, 154-351 tickers per month, and no Date-Ticker duplicates. User-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260529_004/alpha_scores.parquet is missing.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: QVALUE build uses Z_Score_Aligned from load_month_factors; no NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern detected.
factor_db_connector.R align_factor_direction filters IC history with Usable_Date <= sig_date.
Factor inputs are loaded via load_month_factors(sd), not direct factor DB parquet access.
No market regime/DD overlay is used in QVALUE.
Package declares quarterly 45d and annual May lags; factors are sourced through the monthly Factor DB connector.

critical_concerns.description: Composite s_cond ICIR 0.4089 is below the best raw single factor V02_EP ICIR 0.4571. The package compares against value/quality axes and marginal sum, but does not clear the RF-A2 incremental-factor test.

Portfolio diagnostics and claimed SR use top-25 long-only EW while the QEPM hard constraint is max_names=20. The claimed AX-007 exception is not instantiated by an actual multi-sleeve, long-short, 50+ diversification, or ML sizing implementation.
QVALUE liquidity audit reports pct_below_2e8=0.02397. Hard liquidity requires 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW for selected names; an audit-only disclosure is not enforcement.

challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, risk package, and optimization package are absent at the requested WT paths. This blocks RF checklist rebuttal, lineage verification, weight schedule validation, and covariance PSD/condition audit.
Harvey/DSR evidence is within-track only and lacks Newey-West HAC, 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 portfolio regressions, sector-neutral IC, and full cross-cycle trial accounting.
The package labels <=2023-12-22 as lockbox, but QEPM lockbox is sealed from 2024-01-23. Pre-LB, sealed Lockbox, and Combined 3-way reporting are not provided.
Reported lockbox monotonicity is 0.78 versus the alpha gate threshold 0.80, and full-window monotonicity is weaker at 0.6485. Graduation 5/5 PASS omits this failed checklist item.
Core references are paper-name level only and lack page-specific citations; the package does not provide the required <200-char causal chain with page-backed mechanism.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 is not triggered for the package-referenced QVALUE alpha matrix: 267 monthly sig_dates, 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01, variable ticker counts, and no Date-Ticker duplicates.
C13-C15 evidence is materially better than many failed packages: factor construction goes through load_month_factors and Z_Score_Aligned with PIT-safe Usable_Date filtering in the connector.
The package honestly reports s_interact multiplicative noise and high realized return correlation versus STR_1715 instead of hiding them.

Provide sector-neutral IC and RF-A4 evidence.
Produce challenge_note.md with RF-A1~A7 rebuttal and artifact_lineage.json with write_json to record_lineage order.
Provide weights.csv and covariance.parquet at requested paths so schedule, PSD, and post-shrink condition number <=100 can be verified.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that conditional QARP gating is a deployable incremental KR alpha even though s_cond underperforms the best raw single factor V02_EP, uses invalid top-25/liquidity-breaching portfolio diagnostics, and lacks true lockbox plus multi-testing proof.
rebuttal_required: Explain why RF-A2 should not compare s_cond ICIR 0.4089 against V02_EP ICIR 0.4571, or provide a same-constraint portfolio and 5-spec result where s_cond dominates.
Show top-20, liquidity-filtered, 15bps net results with turnover and MDD under QEPM hard constraints.
Submit true sealed-lockbox and combined reports using the 2024-01-23 lockbox boundary.
Submit challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet for AX-008 triangulation.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The alpha matrix itself is not the main failure; the approval layer is. The package overclaims graduation while key hard-constraint, RF-A2, RF-A6, lockbox, and lineage artifacts remain unresolved.

alpha_specific_questions: Can s_cond maintain t_NW > 2.95 after top-20 and strict 2e8 KRW liquidity enforcement?
Why is V02_EP ICIR 0.4571 not the relevant RF-A2 comparator when s_cond ICIR is 0.4089?
